records.title: Autonomous perimeter security for a large open-pit mining operation
records.useCase: Scheduled autonomous drone patrols for perimeter security and intrusion detection across a remote open-pit site
records.statedResults: Reduced manual patrol hours and delivered continuous after-hours perimeter coverage with automated alerting

records.title: Automated flare stack and storage tank inspections at an energy facility
records.useCase: Docked drone-in-a-box inspections of flare stacks and tank farms without shutting down continuous operations
records.statedResults: Cut inspection turnaround time and removed the need for personnel to work at height in a regulated environment

records.title: Yard surveillance and inventory monitoring at a container port
records.useCase: Autonomous aerial monitoring of container yards for security, safety compliance, and periodic inventory checks
records.statedResults: Improved situational awareness across a multi-terminal footprint and shortened incident response times

records.title: Routine substation inspections for an electric utility
records.useCase: Automated recurring inspections of substation equipment using a fixed drone-in-a-box deployment
records.statedResults: Standardized inspection imagery capture and reduced dependence on scheduled manual field visits
